easyPrerequisites:
Stenn has "Artifact" chosen.
You haven't cast an artifact spell using Muldrotha this turn.
description:
Cast the artifact from your graveyard using Muldrotha's ability by paying {0} due to Stenn.

Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Atog by sacrificing the artifact, giving Atog +2/+2 until end of turn
Repeat.
